question: Who among the following has been appointed the Chairperson of the Delimitation Commission for Jammu and Kashmir and some north-eastern states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranjana Prakash Desai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Delimitation Commission was led by **Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai**, a retired Judge of the Supreme Court of India.
 
• **Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai** is a former judge of the Supreme Court of India, and the present head of the Delimitation Commission of India.
 
• She was formerly a **public prosecutor for the State of Maharashtra** and worked as a **judge on the Bombay High Court previous to her appointment from the Supreme Court.**
 
• Ranjana Prakash Desai has been named as **Chairperson of the Press Council of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pinaki Chandra Ghose** was the first Lokpal of India, from** 2019 to 2022. **
 
• **Rajesh Kumar Agrawal **is the present President of the National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) and a **previous judge of the Supreme Court of India.**
 
• **Deepak Gupta** is a former Judge of Supreme Court of India and former Chief Justice of Tripura High Court and Chhattisgarh High Court.
